units.source_text: 却说那藤壶妃子身患小恙，暂时出宫，回三条娘家休养。

en.t: Now Lady Fujitsubo had fallen slightly ill, so she left the palace for a time and returned to her family home at Sanjo to recover.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看见父皇为此忧愁叹息，深感不安。

en.t: Prince Genji saw his father, the emperor, grieving and sighing over this, and he felt deeply uneasy.

units.source_text: 但一方面又颇想乘此良机，与藤壶妃子相会。

en.t: Yet at the same time, he very much wanted to seize this chance to meet Lady Fujitsubo.

units.source_text: 因此神思恍惚，各恋人处都无心去访。

en.t: Because of this, his mind wandered in a daze, and he had no heart to visit any of his lovers.

units.source_text: 无论在宫中或在二条院私邸，总是昼间闷闷不乐，沉思梦想，

en.t: Whether he was in the palace or at his private residence in Nijo, he spent the days sunk in gloom, lost in thought and longing,

units.source_text: 夜间则催促王命妇[\[21\]](#part1334.html#m21)，要她想办法。

en.t: while at night he pressed O no Myobu[\[21\]](#part1334.html#m21), urging her to think of some way.

units.source_text: 王命妇用尽千方百计，竟不顾一切地把两人拉拢了。

en.t: O no Myobu exhausted every possible means and, in the end, disregarding everything, brought the two of them together.

units.source_text: 此次幽会真同做梦一样，心情好生凄楚！

en.t: This secret meeting was truly like a dream, and their hearts were filled with desolate sorrow.

units.source_text: 藤壶妃子回想以前那桩伤心之事，觉得抱恨终天，

en.t: Lady Fujitsubo thought back on that painful affair from before and felt that she would carry the bitterness for the rest of her life,

units.source_text: 早已决心誓不再犯；岂料如今又遭此厄，思想起来，好不愁闷！

en.t: for she had long ago resolved and sworn never to repeat it; yet now she had met this calamity again, and the thought filled her with anguish.

units.source_text: 但此人生性温柔敦厚，腼腆多情。

en.t: But by nature she was gentle, sincere, shy, and deeply feeling.

units.source_text: 虽然伤心饮恨，其高贵之相终非常人可比。

en.t: Though wounded by sorrow and forced to swallow her resentment, her noble bearing was still beyond comparison with ordinary people.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想道：“此人身上何以毫无半点缺陷呢？”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "How can there be not even the slightest flaw in this person?"

units.source_text: 他觉得这一点反而令人难以忍受了。

en.t: He felt that this very perfection made her all the harder to bear.

units.source_text: 虽然相逢，匆促之间岂能畅叙？

en.t: Although they had met, how could they speak freely in such a hurried moment?

units.source_text: 惟愿永远同宿于暗夜之中。

en.t: He wished only that they might lie together forever in the dark night.

units.source_text: 但春宵苦短，转瞬已近黎明。

en.t: But the spring night was painfully short, and in an instant dawn was already near.

units.source_text: 惜别伤离，真有“相见争如不见”之感。

en.t: As they grieved over parting and suffered at separation, they truly felt that meeting was worse than never meeting at all.
